title: T1589 — Gather Victim Identity Information
subtitle: Interactive walkthrough of Gather Victim Identity Information with the technique-specific attack path and defender evidence.
aria: Animated simulation: Identity reconnaissance campaign against a fictional company. It shows each step of the technique and what defenders can see. A written version of every step is in the story below the canvas. Use the step buttons under the canvas, or focus the canvas and press the left and right arrow keys.

nodes.label: Attacker
nodes.tip: Plans the reconnaissance, harvests public data, and prepares the later attack. Everything they do here happens outside your network.

nodes.label: Public web
nodes.tip: Your website and professional profiles. Team pages, press releases, and job ads reveal names, roles, and email formats.

nodes.label: Leak forum
nodes.tip: Criminal markets that resell email and password pairs from old breaches of other companies.

nodes.label: Mail gateway
nodes.tip: Your mail edge. The first corporate telemetry the campaign touches when phishing emails arrive.

nodes.label: Employees
nodes.tip: People whose names, roles, and addresses were harvested. IT, finance, and HR are the usual priorities.

nodes.label: Intel feeds
nodes.tip: Certificate transparency and leak monitoring services that can spot reconnaissance outside your network.

nodes.label: SOC
nodes.tip: Your detection and response team. They act on user reports, feed alerts, and gateway telemetry.

steps.caption: The attacker chooses Aurelia Pay, a fast-growing payments company, as the next target. No company system has been touched.
steps.defender: Nothing to see yet. Target selection happens entirely outside your visibility.
